query: WITH scope_tracks(track_id) AS (SELECT id FROM tracks WHERE availability IN (?, ?)) SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM artists ar WHERE ar.id = ? AND (ar.id IN (SELECT ta.artist_id FROM track_artists ta JOIN scope_tracks st ON st.track_id = ta.track_id) OR ar.id IN (SELECT aa.artist_id FROM album_artists aa WHERE aa.album_id IN ( SELECT t.album_id FROM tracks t JOIN scope_tracks st ON st.track_id = t.id))))
